Rumors circulating online claim that Menace, a female supervillain, will be a part of **Spider-Man: Brand New Day**. She is rumored to be played by Sadie Sink. While ongoing speculation about a potential villain hasn't been confirmed, many fans remain invested in learning more about Menace's origins and abilities. So, here's all you need to know.

## Who is Lily Hollister, aka Menace, in Marvel comics?
**Lily Hollister, also known as Menace, is the ex-fiancée of Harry Osborn and a member of the Goblin underground.**
Lily Hollister debuted in Amazing Spider-Man Vol. 1 #545 as the daughter of district attorney William Hollister. She initially appeared as Harry Osborn's wealthy girlfriend, although Harry remained deeply in love with a clone created by an artificial intelligence based on Norman Osborn.
Lily embraced her supervillain identity after she accidentally exposed herself to Norman Osborn's old chemical formulas, which transformed her into the grey-skinned Menace. As Menace, she developed impressive powers and adopted the violent tendencies characteristic of the Goblins.

## Is Menace the villain of Spider-Man 4: Brand New Day?
**Menace is rumored to be the villain in Spider-Man 4: Brand New Day.**
The rumors began after the official title of Spider-Man 4 was revealed. Industry insider MyTimeToShineHello believes that the new film's plot might draw from the Brand New Day comic storyline, in which Menace plays a key antagonistic role. Moreover, many fans believe Sadie Sink may be cast as Menace, since her role has reportedly been described as "significant," according to Deadline.

## What are Menace's powers in Marvel comics?
After being exposed to Osborn's chemical particles, Menace developed several superhuman abilities. These include superhuman strength, stamina, durability, speed, agility, and reflexes. She also possesses regenerative healing and transformation abilities.
In addition to her powers, Menace uses a Mark 7 Goblin Glider for transportation. She also makes use of specialized equipment, including Pumpkin Bombs, bulletproof armor, and other strange portable incendiary devices.

American actress and singer Zendaya has released one studio album, 10 singles, three promotional singles, 15 music videos and several album appearances. In 2011, she independently released her debut single, "Swag It Out". Her next single, "Watch Me", peaked at number 86 on the US _Billboard_ Hot 100.
On August 8, 2012, Zendaya signed to Hollywood Records and began writing songs for her debut album.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zendaya_discography#cite_note-hr-1) Her debut single, "Replay", was released on July 16, 2013, produced by Mick Schultz and written by Tiffany Fred and Paul "Phamous" Shelton. Her debut album, _Zendaya_, was released on September 17, 2013, and reached number 51 on the US _Billboard_ 200.[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zendaya_discography#cite_note-bb200-2)

On March 6, 2015, Timbaland confirmed that he would be working with Zendaya on her second album.[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zendaya_discography#cite_note-3) Speaking on the album, Zendaya told MTV News that the music is a "new wave of R&B. It's where I think it should be going, or it should be headed; it's very old-school vibe, but it's a new age version."[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zendaya_discography#cite_note-mtv.com-4) In July 2015, Zendaya posted a snippet of a song produced by Timbaland on Instagram. Following this, she appeared on a radio station in Dubai and premiered a longer snippet of the song entitled "Close Up". On November 8, 2015, she posted another video of her lip-syncing to an R&B song which would be included on her then-upcoming album.[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zendaya_discography#cite_note-mtv.com-4) A music video for the song was released by Hunger TV on November 12, 2015.[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zendaya_discography#cite_note-5) The single "Something New" featuring Chris Brown was released on February 5, 2016, via Hollywood Records and Republic Records.[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zendaya_discography#cite_note-6)

On September 17, 2013, Zendaya released her self-titled debut studio album through Hollywood Records. The 11-track album blended pop, R&B, electropop and other contemporary sounds, and featured “Replay” as its lead single.
“Replay” became a major early milestone for Zendaya, reaching No. 40 on the Billboard Hot 100. The album itself debuted at No. 51 on the Billboard 200.
I still have so much nostalgia for Zendaya’s self-titled album. I remember seeing her go from Shake It Up to taking music seriously and showing that she could have an identity as a recording artist, too. “Replay” is obviously the standout for me, but I also love looking back at the rest of the album because it captures that early-2010s pop and R&B sound so well.
It’s crazy to think that it has already been 13 years, especially knowing how much Zendaya’s career has evolved since then.

American actress and singer Zendaya has released one studio album, 10 singles, three promotional singles, 15 music videos and several album appearances. In 2011, she independently released her debut single, "Swag It Out". Her next single, "Watch Me", peaked at number 86 on the US _Billboard_ Hot 100.
On August 8, 2012, Zendaya signed to Hollywood Records and began writing songs for her debut album.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zendaya_discography#cite_note-hr-1) Her debut single, "Replay", was released on July 16, 2013, produced by Mick Schultz and written by Tiffany Fred and Paul "Phamous" Shelton. Her debut album, _Zendaya_, was released on September 17, 2013, and reached number 51 on the US _Billboard_ 200.[[2]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zendaya_discography#cite_note-bb200-2)
texts.1: On March 6, 2015, Timbaland confirmed that he would be working with Zendaya on her second album.[[3]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zendaya_discography#cite_note-3) Speaking on the album, Zendaya told MTV News that the music is a "new wave of R&B. It's where I think it should be going, or it should be headed; it's very old-school vibe, but it's a new age version."[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zendaya_discography#cite_note-mtv.com-4) In July 2015, Zendaya posted a snippet of a song produced by Timbaland on Instagram. Following this, she appeared on a radio station in Dubai and premiered a longer snippet of the song entitled "Close Up". On November 8, 2015, she posted another video of her lip-syncing to an R&B song which would be included on her then-upcoming album.[[4]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zendaya_discography#cite_note-mtv.com-4) A music video for the song was released by Hunger TV on November 12, 2015.[[5]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zendaya_discography#cite_note-5) The single "Something New" featuring Chris Brown was released on February 5, 2016, via Hollywood Records and Republic Records.[[6]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Zendaya_discography#cite_note-6)

# Pop Culture - On September 17, 2013, Zendaya released her... | Facebook
## Pop Culture's Post
[September 17](https://www.facebook.com/PopCultureUpdates/posts/pfbid0jKi3dN3TSJnATfQAd5Q8ij8cAsXA78oqtPXfFYCcLFqd5QNnQaj4wqeLhiUDGXEQl?__cft__[0]=AZgsgyRxXgHFRpKWtP3uePTT-PURCnQxk_JreBEcnz2SewYGS86h2r9KlyCHqKG6qy2XUs5RgtEt3w5t5EjCEcp8FlDGPW-muB9jrpvl-qukCx51BvY3XnCsrB29DyVKawaR9j6i2JkYCUF-DX7s8d20r2S-6Vjl&__tn__=%2CO%2CP-R) ·
On September 17, 2013, Zendaya released her self-titled debut studio album through Hollywood Records. The 11-track album blended pop, R&B, electropop and other contemporary sounds, and featured “Replay” as its lead single.
“Replay” became a major early milestone for Zendaya, reaching No. 40 on the Billboard Hot 100. The album itself debuted at No. 51 on the Billboard 200.
I still have so much nostalgia for Zendaya’s self-titled album. I remember seeing her go from Shake It Up to taking music seriously and showing that she could have an identity as a recording artist, too. “Replay” is obviously the standout for me, but I also love looking back at the rest of the album because it captures that early-2010s pop and R&B sound so well.
It’s crazy to think that it has already been 13 years, especially knowing how much Zendaya’s career has evolved since then.
